## 1. Purpose

Following review of updated North River Emergency Management Division continuity-of-operations guidance (issued after NREOCRC-OPR-001), the Owner is amending the minimum standby power duration requirement. Except as expressly amended, all other provisions of NREOCRC-OPR-001 (as amended by NREOCRC-ADD-01) remain unchanged and in full force.

## 2. Amendment to Section 12.1 (Standby Power Requirements)

Section 12.1 is deleted in its entirety and replaced with the following:

**12.1** [MANDATORY] The Facility shall be provided with standby power generation capacity sufficient to support full EOC-activated load — comprising the Secure Zone, EOC Operations Room, Communications spaces, and life-safety systems for the balance of the Facility — for a continuous period of no less than **120 hours** without refuelling, at design-basis ambient conditions.

## 3. No Other Change to Section 12

This Addendum amends Section 12.1 only. Sections 12.2 (Standby Power Sizing Reference table), 12.3, and 12.4 are not amended by this Addendum and remain as issued in NREOCRC-OPR-001, Rev. 0.

## 4. Design-Builder Note

The Owner draws the Design-Builder's attention to Section 2.4 of NREOCRC-OPR-001 (precedence between text, tables, and figures) in coordinating this amendment with other OPR provisions that reference standby power duration or fuel storage capacity.
